body:
# the contributor audit of the mixed Stein identities and the strengthened obstruction

The root read the complete mixed graph-flux identity, the trapezoid
construction, and the centrally symmetric active-pair construction.
Both exact verifiers were run and pass. The Sympy trapezoid verifier
requires `work/math-venv/bin/python`; the system Python lacks Sympy.

The flow divergence sign, all closed-tail atoms, and each within-fiber
coarea factor check. The trapezoid cap regimes prove an actual global
depth maximum, with an explicit balanced three-cap cover. The later
symmetric example proves the stronger assertion of negative flux for
BOTH members of an equal-budget active balanced pair. Its measure is
exactly H_2, its center belongs to the original S, and the symmetry proof
includes closed ambient halfspaces carrying boundary mass. Its depth is
1/2, so the example does not address a below-OC minimizing-body budget.

The single-simplex second-variation theorem was also read in full. The
reciprocal-Laplace curvature formula, strictness, positive-coordinate
Hessian signs, repeated coefficients, zero vertex margins, and attained
edge-intercept cap formula all check. Constituent fiber stationarity is
not supplied by this theorem.

## A removed overstatement in the isolated-fiber flux lemma

The valid lemma assumes every cap has ZERO mass in every nonanchor fiber.
Its proof uses this to obtain `J_j=D a_j.(g_anchor-g)`. A condition only
on outside barycenters cannot replace the zero-mass assumption. The
unjustified extension was removed after the root audit.

Here is an exact finite-measure certificate, with the anchor in the
actual support. At index zero put

`mu_0=(3/4)delta_1+(1/4)delta_(-100)+delta_0`,

and at index one put

`mu_1=(1/4)delta_3+(3/4)delta_(-1)`.

The anchor is `(0,0)`. Use the two closed cap margins
`L_+(z,x)=x-z/2` and `L_-(z,x)=-x-z/2`. Each cap has mass two, and their
raw continuous normals balance with equal weights. The outside fiber
barycenter is `(1,0)`, strictly outside both caps.

Nevertheless direct substitution into
`J=sum_z (m_z-m) mu_z{L>=0}` gives

`J_+=-155/32`, `J_-=-101/96`,
`J_++J_-=-283/48<0`.

All these identities were independently evaluated using exact Fraction
arithmetic. This certificate concerns the broadly stated finite-measure
lemma only; these atomic measures are not asserted to be the prescribed
uniform intrinsic measures of a mixed convex body. The valid zero-outside-
mass lemma and the corrected trapezoid computation remain intact.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
